$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: Community-Spec-1.0. FPSOT identity and access event data (IAM-090 to IAM-095). The record attributes, such as the time, the event name and the trace identifier, are set by the FPSOT observability specification.
title: org.fpsot.identity.relationship.ended
description: A role, a grant or a representation ends or is revoked.

outcome.description: The outcome, a code list value (NAM-060).

actorId.description: The opaque identifier of the person or workload that acts, such as the sub of IAM-036.

clientId.description: The identifier of the OAuth client.

sessionId.description: An opaque session identifier, such as the OpenID Connect sid or a keyed hash. It is never the value of the session cookie (IAM-091).

assuranceLevel.description: The FPSOT level of the session, under IAM-002.

representedPartyId.description: The party that the person acts for, under IAM-064.

items.description: An opaque identifier. It is never a name, an email address or a number that identifies a person (IAM-093).

actChain.description: Each actor of the act chain after a token exchange, outermost first (IAM-091).
